headlines.title: Prince Harry and Meghan to make U.K. their 'primary residence,' reports say
headlines.description: Prince Harry and his family will leave Southern California and return to the United Kingdom, according to sources for The Telegraph based in the U.K. NBC News' Daniele Hamamdjian reports.

headlines.title: How Sen. Darline Graham’s debate blunder could give undecided voters ‘some pause’
headlines.description: Shelby Talcott, Steve Ricchetti and Ashley Davis join the Meet the Press NOW panel to discuss Sen. Darline Graham’s (R-S.C.) debate performance and key gaps in national security expertise compared to her late brother Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.).

headlines.title: Telemundo executive among 7 killed in Kenya helicopter crash
headlines.description: Five Americans are dead following a helicopter crash in a remote area of northern Kenya, the U.S.

headlines.title: Merck and Moderna say cancer vaccine shows signs of preventing recurrence of melanoma
headlines.description: Pharmaceutical giants Moderna and Merck said that an experimental vaccine treatment has shown signs of preventing cancer from returning or spreading in a study of high-risk melanoma patients. NBC News health reporter Aria Bendix explains what happens next.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Democrats are in their post-resistance era: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Prince Harry and Meghan will move back to the United Kingdom, source says
headlines.description: Prince Harry and his family will leave the sunny shores of Southern California and return to the United Kingdom, a source familiar with the couple’s plans said.

headlines.title: NASA mission to save its sinking space telescope fails
headlines.description: NASA had hoped to prevent its Swift observatory from breaking apart in Earth’s atmosphere. But the spacecraft tasked with the rescue hit problems.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to tainted jalapenos isn’t over, as CDC reports more than 400 cases
headlines.description: The CDC reported more than 400 cases in 32 states, although the number of illnesses is likely to be much higher.

headlines.title: New CDC director pledges to ‘speak truth’ about science
headlines.description: Dr. Erica Schwartz addressed CDC employees Wednesday in her first agencywide meeting.

headlines.title: Book him: Prosecutors using James Comey’s novel against him in seashells case
headlines.description: Comey’s novel centers on a villain who sends coded messages urging retaliation against his political rivals. In new filings, federal attorneys argue that life imitated art.

headlines.title: Trump admin was warned about peeling Reflecting Pool before it brought vandalism case
headlines.description: A National Park Service engineer warned the Trump administration about the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool peeling in early June due to the renovation issues.
